# SD Solutions

> > SD Solutions is a global scaling partner providing staff augmentation, recruitment process outsourcing, employer of record, and business process outsourcing services to tech companies worldwide.

SD Solutions specializes in end-to-end staffing and HR solutions for tech companies, with operations across Eastern Europe, Latin America, and serving clients in the USA, UK, and Israel. The company combines talent acquisition, workforce management, and business process optimization to help organizations scale globally.

## Key Topics

- Staff Augmentation
- Employer of Record (EoR)
- Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)
- Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)
- Global Scaling
- Dedicated Teams
- Tech Staffing
- Nearshore Hiring

- Eastern Europe & Latin America
- Tipalti, Perion Group

## Core Services

- [Staff Augmentation](https://www.sdsolutions.tech/staff-augmentation-service): Staff augmentation service transforming hiring strategy with flexible scaling and dedicated teams.
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing](https://www.sdsolutions.tech/recruitment-process-outsourcing-service): RPO service providing end-to-end recruitment and technical staffing solutions globally.
- [Employer of Record Service](https://www.sdsolutions.tech/employer-of-record-service): EoR service enabling global hiring with payroll compliance and workforce management.
- [Business Process Outsourcing](https://www.sdsolutions.tech/business-process-oursourcing-service): BPO solutions for IT companies offering front/back-office operations and customer support.
